title: Syrian-Style Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry with chicken, rice, and a blend of Syrian spices. Serve with a side of naan bread or pita.

ingredients.name: Syrian spice blend
ingredients.notes: make sure to include cumin, coriander, and sumac

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add the onion, garlic, bell pepper, and tomato.
Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the Syrian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
